needs.premise: One prospective worker, one GC movement and one activation; root payload opaque, registry and result observations atomic. No C weak-memory or liveness proof.
Selective custody, version/reload and cleanup lemmas under explicit guards, not complete source or QNT simulation.
Full caller location/handle acquired before on_all_processors and possible resize GC; ordinary startup procedure permanence must be proved per generated profile.
Stable VM descriptor is scanned independently of processor_count; valid source until child accepts; child may run before create returns. Known create error excludes child; lost result does not.
No cached movable thunk across sync; context binding and exact collector epoch are ready before root reload and activation acceptance.
Activation slots fully initialized before registration; source overlap until accepted; marker failure/rethrow funnel after END_TRY; unique marker clear/drop before status.
Explicit registry lock or equivalent snapshot/pin protocol; scalar release/acquire cannot alone establish moving-root scan exclusion. POSIX create success does not cover later collector writes.

Transfer registered startup/worker thunk origin before worker publication/read/synchronization, then root before marker; cover ___call rethrow and known marker failure with post-END_TRY canonical cleanup; source data_scmobj alone is not root coverage.
One custodian records marker initialized/cleared/count drop and root/status transfer; preserve setjmp-defined state, original error, frame/catcher and unknown-progress custody.

Collector-updateable RootView scanner for every context, nested view lifetime, native borrow exclusion, old-reader pin and relocation reload; processor0 RC scanning does not close arbitrary-owner roots.

callers.actualChain: ##cvmr -> ##current-vm-resize c-lambda -> sop.arg[0] -> on_all_processors -> vm_resize -> possible GC
callers.hazard: Root source before sync publication or first GC; ordinary callers supply ##startup-processor!, not a demonstrated movable closure.
callers.replacement: Select profile/generated procedure identity and full CFUN argument root map. Arbitrary thunk route requires stronger handle admission.

callers.actualChain: setup pstate -> set processor_count -> fill thread descriptor -> OS create
callers.hazard: Current membership becomes visible before OS threads are created; stable root descriptor must exist before collector-visible membership and keep identity through partial creation.
callers.replacement: Do not reorder existing barrier algorithm blindly. Separate planned membership from runnable/GC membership, or prove existing protocol with descriptors.

callers.actualChain: start_processor_execution loads raw thunk -> binds pstate -> sync loop -> run_and_throw -> ___run
callers.hazard: Remove early raw thunk cache; acquire bootstrap lease, synchronize with no raw borrow, obtain context seal and reload, then activation handoff.
callers.replacement: Do not use t->thread_id written after pthread_create as pre-entry readiness; child-before-return is admitted.

callers.actualChain: setup_modules permanent descriptor -> program_descr -> first module thunk -> ___run
callers.hazard: Descriptor vectors use make_vector(NULL); certify selected thunk lifetime separately, then share activation entry protocol.
callers.replacement: A permanent descriptor container alone does not prove all reachable thunks permanent; generated module binding evidence remains open.

callers.actualChain: ___run marker allocation -> ___call normal/rethrow -> outer catcher -> status
callers.hazard: Source and marker ownership live in canonical scope record; clear/drop/root retirement in one exit funnel after catcher restoration.
callers.replacement: Do not store sole cleanup progress in modified nonvolatile setjmp locals; unknown decrement is not replayable.

allocators.actualPath: Raw thunk travels through sop and C parameters before growth GC
allocators.contract: Create descriptor with safe false slots and valid origin, register VM root before on_all_processors; reload at each use after possible movement.
allocators.failure: Allocation failure occurs while caller full view still valid; no descriptor publication with incomplete scan map.
allocators.custodian: Caller owns until VM acceptance; parent borrow cannot survive park without freeze/reload.

allocators.contract: Reserve one lease per prospective child before OS call; commit one child identity independently of creator result arrival.
allocators.failure: Known failure releases only failed child reservation; previously created children stay rooted. Unknown outcome retains lease.
allocators.custodian: VM bootstrap registry, never dead creator/PSTATE-only list.

allocators.actualPath: Raw cache precedes loop capable of GC
allocators.contract: Loop executes with root token only; context-ready acquire and collector-updated slot reload occur after final sync and again after any allocation window.
allocators.failure: GC-done is not context-ready; use-after-reload allocation needs its own live mapped root.
allocators.custodian: Bootstrap lease until activation root acceptance with matching identity/epoch.

allocators.contract: Prepare nonmoving native metadata under valid source; FAL-initialize slots; register; accept source; allocate marker; reload thunk for marker store; commit marker ownership.
allocators.failure: Partial marker construction retains unique initialization duty; known failure goes to common cleanup.
allocators.custodian: NativeActivationScope pinned independently of C catcher locals.

allocators.actualPath: Call can rethrow past inline kill
allocators.contract: Restore outer catcher, claim cleanup, record clear then count drop, retire roots only after scan readers drain, return original err.
allocators.failure: Unknown clear/drop retains scope; failed/unknown join does not authorize retirement.
allocators.custodian: One canonical cleanup claimant; no wait for callback while holding registry lock.

orders.orderContract: Full caller root map and safe slots precede release registry insertion; collector acquires/pins exact descriptor generation.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Raw C parameter, sop argument and W_ALL alone are not new all-domain scanner proofs.

orders.orderContract: Descriptor insertion and child lease precede processor membership/create; OS entry acquires stable descriptor without relying on creator return.
orders.rejectedShortcut: pthread_create synchronizes creation-time writes, not later root relocation. Preserve actual return code, not ambient errno.

orders.orderContract: Registry snapshot holds descriptor pin; relocation excludes raw owner access; retirement closes admission then drains snapshot readers.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Do not hold registry lock across GC barrier, pthread_join or Scheme callback; avoid GC/creator/child cycles.

orders.orderContract: Collector slot update and context binding precede resume release; child acquires, reloads and accepts under same epoch.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Thread binding alone or sync NOOP is not proof that all resume prerequisites hold.

orders.orderContract: Child acceptance recorded before source lease ACK; duplicate ACK is identity-checked; last lease release cannot erase a live activation.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Unknown create/ACK and ignored join keep custody, not a retry that creates a second child.

orders.orderContract: END_TRY catcher restore precedes clear/count/root/status funnel; progress lives outside indeterminate setjmp locals.
orders.rejectedShortcut: A nonallocating decrement is neither idempotent nor automatically safe to replay.

costs.removedWork: Replace N raw thread thunk caches with one relocatable value cell plus N identity leases
costs.bound: Value slot bytes N*w -> w if one shared thunk and joint scan protocol; saving (N-1)*w
costs.addedCost: Descriptor H, N leases L and scan-reader metadata R; O(N) lifecycle work remains
costs.condition: Value sharing alone wins bytes only when (N-1)*w > H+N*L+R relative to replaced support. No claimed total saving.

costs.removedWork: Scan one shared bootstrap cell once instead of N registered duplicate cells
costs.bound: N -> 1 slot visits per GC for this cell, only while at least one lease exists
costs.addedCost: N child lease/accounting operations and active marker roots remain
costs.condition: Current raw data_scmobj scanning is not established; compare safe modern C alternatives, not unsafe baseline scan=0.

costs.removedWork: Remove stale raw thunk lifetime across moving epoch
costs.bound: At least one post-loop load per successful worker; another after marker allocation if it can GC
costs.addedCost: Acquire/context check and explicit reload per allocation boundary
costs.condition: No extra Scheme evaluation, native create or closure copy; compiler barrier alone is insufficient.

costs.removedWork: Reuse one root/exit contract for two actual run families
costs.bound: A active scopes, at most two dedicated slots each -> 2*A*w before proven alias elision
costs.addedCost: Record/map/pin overhead and still marker backing counted separately
costs.condition: No requirement to allocate duplicate slots when existing permanent/owned-still authority is certified.

costs.removedWork: Avoid duplicate OS creation and source-root loss
costs.bound: One canonical creation attempt per child generation until actual result settles
costs.addedCost: Unknown U attempts retain U*L plus shared H/root and possible native stacks/PSTATEs
costs.condition: No bounded peak or eventual recovery without result/stop evidence; process fatal path is not recoverable success.

costs.removedWork: Count unique thunk backing once across source/descriptor/activation overlap
costs.addedCost: B_values excludes marker/native/metadata backing; U_extra excludes unknown stacks/leases already counted; overlap may increase peak
costs.condition: Positive total/runtime performance remains open; no benchmark, percent or person-days.

costs.removedWork: Replace early worker thunk read, raw descriptor carrier and normal-only kill assumption
costs.bound: Two ___run caller families; zero runtime paths retired in this study
costs.addedCost: All-context scanner, producer admission, platform failure and common cleanup must migrate together
costs.condition: Retire old ownership duties only after source/C-order/native gates; keep Scheme, tail calls, continuation and C portability.

costs.removedWork: Modern C keeps one generated/runtime protocol and C ABI
costs.bound: No Zig-specific reduction proved for root/lease/GC/cleanup state
costs.addedCost: Zig would still need same protocol, scanner and platform contracts
costs.condition: Modern C is required mainline; Zig is optional only with separate demonstrated net value.

nodes.labelText: Drain root readers and deliver status

transitions.guardContract: Caller view valid; allocate non-GC metadata, FAL slots and map before linking
VM root visible and prospective child lease reserved before membership/create
Stable descriptor identity; may precede creator result; bind PSTATE before synchronization
Actual OS failure or external no-child evidence; never timeout
Loop completion plus exact resume context/binding; no movable raw cache
Acquire context-ready and read collector-updated cell for current epoch
Initialize safe slots, register/pin scope, accept same identity before source ACK; canonical result settled
Marker root exists before allocation; reload proc after allocation; failure retains duty
Outer catcher restored; preserve original status and marker presence
Single canonical progress record; clear before one count drop; no sole modified setjmp local
Known settled marker or never-created marker; root readers drained externally
Root/marker custody settled; native descriptor can still retain unresolved creation outcome
